description: Resources required for information security and privacy protection are not determined, documented, and allocated as part of organizational capital planning and investment control processes.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing resource allocation documentation, absence of security and privacy budget line items, lack of capital planning integration for security requirements, missing cost estimates for security controls, and inadequate funding for security and privacy protection activities.
